mentions.name: RatherSay
mentions.description: A voice-input-only social media platform where users post using voice and pictures, with typing disabled entirely. Built in a weekend with Lovable.
mentions.source_excerpt: I made a voice-input only social media. It has pictures too. But you can't type anything. Made it in a weekend with Lovable.
